data.title: Border town suffers as Malaysians bypass old checkpoint
data.description: SONGKHLA - The Thai border town that hosts the old — and still operational — border checkpoint with Malaysia has seen business fall off sharply since a new checkpoint opened just a kilometre away.

data.title: Court acquits 'Aem Cyanide' of sixth murder charge
data.description: The Criminal Court has acquitted convicted poisoner Sararat "Aem Cyanide" Rangsiwuthaporn of the sixth murder case brought against her.

data.title: PTTEP announces first-half performance of 2026 and interim dividend payment at 4.50 baht per share
data.description: Bangkok, 31 July 2026 – PTTEP announced its operational progress for the first half of 2026, maintaining natural gas production at full capacity to help mitigate the energy crisis arising from the ongoing Middle East conflict and to safeguard the country’s energy security. During the period, the company contributed over 27,700 million baht to the government to support national development and deliver continuous shareholder returns, with an approved interim dividend of 4.50 baht per share.

data.title: Virtual banks reshape Thailand’s lending landscape as debt risks draw attention
data.description: Thailand’s virtual banking era promises wider access to credit, but regulators warn borrowers must understand repayment obligations as online lending expands.

data.title: Guatemala issues 'danger' alert after Fuego volcano erupts
data.description: GUATEMALA CITY — Guatemalan authorities issued the country's second-highest emergency alert level on Monday after a major eruption of Central America's most active volcano, prompting the evacuation of nearby villages.

data.title: Myanmar ex-junta chief set for first Thailand visit as civilian leader
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — Myanmar's ex-junta chief Min Aung Hlaing is expected in Thailand on Thursday, making his first trip there since becoming civilian leader as he seeks a return to the diplomatic fold for his pariah state.

data.title: Arson suspect arrested as US northwest battles wildfires
data.description: SPOKANE (UNITED STATES) — US authorities arrested a man Monday on suspicion of arson in connection with the biggest of three fires burning around the northwestern city of Spokane, as firefighters raced to contain flames that have displaced tens of thousands.

data.title: ANA flight makes evasive manoeuvre before landing at Tokyo's Haneda airport
data.description: An All Nippon Airways flight from Shanghai made an evasive manoeuvre while approaching Haneda airport around 6am (4am Thailand time) on Tuesday, the company said.

data.title: Britain's Royal Mint strikes gold in electronic waste
data.description: LLANTRISANT (WALES) - At the heart of Britain's coin factory, old Bank of England telephones are stripped down and dipped into giant vats to recover a hidden treasure: the gold in their circuits.

data.title: Protests force pause in Yala flood retention plan
data.description: A public hearing on the controversial water retention project to prevent flooding in southern Yala city has been put on hold amid growing protests by community leaders and environmentalists.

data.title: ONE Championship: Abdallah Ondash tells Prajanchai ‘you are next’ after 19-second KO
data.description: Abdallah Ondash has told undisputed strawweight Muay Thai champion Prajanchai PK Saenchai “you are next” after delivering a 19-second knockout that strengthened his claim for a ONE Championship title opportunity.

data.title: Chinese man gets 46 years for illegal Pattaya arsenal
data.description: A Chinese man has been sentenced to 46 years in prison for the illegal possession of military-grade weapons, C4 explosive, signal-jamming equipment and other prohibited military hardware.

data.title: Wild elephant calf dies only days after being rescued
data.description: KANCHANABURI - The newborn elephant calf separated from its herd and then rescued from a jungle stream in this western province last week died early Tuesday morning.

data.title: Thailand's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Islay Bomogao asks Chatri for 105lb division after earning US$100,000 contract
data.description: Islay Erika Bomogao has asked ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong to create a new 105lb division after earning a US$100,000 contract in Bangkok.

data.title: Trapped by war, Bangladesh seafarer recounts Gulf ordeal
data.description: DHAKA - For 115 days, captain Mohammad Shafiqul Islam was stranded on the high seas of the Gulf, watching missiles light up the night sky and rationing food and water for his crew.

data.title: North Korea advises citizens to eat dog meat to beat the summer heat
data.description: SEOUL — North Korea’s state media has recommended dog meat soup as protection against summer heat, reviving Pyongyang’s long-running effort to promote the controversial dish as record high temperatures grip both sides of the Korean peninsula.

data.title: Ships passing through key Gulf waterways amid uncertain peace talks
data.description: SINGAPORE - Shipping ⁠traffic ⁠at the key Gulf ​waterways of Bab el-Mandeb and Strait of Hormuz held largely ​unchanged at the ‌start of the week, shipping data showed, as the progress of talks between the United States and Iran remained ambiguous.
